text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning
numerous races with Verxina—
choice_data_list: You should probably get going with this.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'hot springs trip ticket'?
From the lottery?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, you can get plenty of rest now.
Yeah, I can get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, she asked me to hand over the ticket once she had calmed down.
Now is surely that time.
choice_data_list: Go on, take your time and relax with someone dear to you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, the old me...
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...You must be tired too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind,
those tickets—
choice_data_list: I'm fine! I love public baths anyway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly declined. Knowing how kind she is,
she probably meant to give up her spot for me,
but she's the one who worked so hard to get here; she should go.
choice_data_list: I'm fine on my own, so—
I'm enough on my own, so—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Then—!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter if there are "two" of you, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later... for some reason, I found myself traveling to a hot spring inn together with Verxina—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
......Well then,
shall we head to the hot springs first?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah...
Y-yeah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
How was it?
The water felt wonderful, didn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that really soothed me...
Yeah, I feel so much better...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Public baths are nice, but hot springs
are clearly superior when it comes to soothing fatigue."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"You worked hard alongside me, after all...
Please don't say something so lonely as being all by yourself."
choice_data_list: Ah, so that's why... you were a little mad.
Ah, so that's why... you were a bit upset.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...
That is not all.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Would you care to take a short walk with me?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Nice breeze.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
choice_data_list: ...Verxina?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...It's strange, isn't it?
Getting this nervous."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because... the person who was always behind me
is standing right in front of me now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The one who gives me that push on the back,
so I can hold my ground on that final step... is you."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Then when that person is in front of me...
who's going to give me courage?
choice_data_list: Then I'll take it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: Just one last step. Go on, take it... right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping back a bit, I spread my arms. Of course,
she doesn't dive in—she understands
that the gesture isn't meant for that.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...What a way to put it.
Honestly... you really are something else."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...So, what I'm trying to say is...
Family is important, of course, but..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To me, you're number one. But...
please don't go excluding yourself like that.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...It's not that you're...
second best or anything.
choice_data_list: ...Being your number two is more of an honor than I deserve.
...Being second to you is more than an honor.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: L-Like I said, that's not what—
choice_data_list: You'll always be my number one, though.
You'll always be number one in my heart, though.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Please, let it be so.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Letting someone like me finish in second place is simply unacceptable!
choice_data_list: Understood, my queen.
Understood, my queen.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Please don't do that
in front of my little sisters, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a precious moment
where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Verxina...
